Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer asserted that Britannica “confirms” the foundry as “Cold Spring Foundry (also known as the West Point Foundry)” without opening or citing a Britannica page. This mislabels the entity and introduces a non-primary name, while the correct and primary historical name is “West Point Foundry.” The claim was based only on a search results page, not verified content, leading toward an incorrect solution.
